release: Defender Picker Release Gate Compatibility Fix
name: Defender Picker Release Gate Compatibility Fix
changes: Completes the Windows Defender Picker packaging hotfix after the first v3.6.90 canonical workflow correctly stopped on obsolete historical whole-builder fingerprint guards.
Carries forward the v3.6.90 NewzDeckPicker.exe normal-metadata -H windowsgui build unchanged; NewzDeckPicker.go behavior remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Updates the v3.6.79 and v3.6.80 historical release guards to validate the accepted yEnc and Picker helper invariants instead of pinning the entire pre-Picker build-portable.py blob.

Adds a v3.6.91 regression guard proving the obsolete whole-builder blob pins are gone while the yEnc/default routing expression, Picker build override, native failure propagation and LF checkout protections remain enforced.
Preserves all v3.6.89 application behavior and the v3.6.90 Windows build hardening; this release changes release-gate compatibility plus version identity only.
regression_guards: NewzDeckPicker.go remains the reviewed c2552887 Git blob and NewzDeckYenc.go remains the reviewed 38f6df7e Git blob.
build-portable.py must retain PICKER_GO_LDFLAGS = -H windowsgui, the Picker-first helper routing, and the historical yEnc/default routing expression.
validate-v3679-regressions.py and validate-v3680-regressions.py may no longer pin the obsolete v3.6.78 whole-builder blob hash.
The canonical workflow still makes native Python/Node/Go failures fatal and validates Picker build ID/symbol retention before release publication.
All v3.6.82-v3.6.90 application regressions are carried forward with v3.6.91 payload fingerprints.
